title: Junior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company:** VGDS Global LLP  
**Location:** Hybrid (Remote, with two mandatory office visit per month)  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year (Freshers can apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About VGDS Global LLP

VGDS Global LLP is a presentation design and business communication company based in Kochi, Kerala. We work with international clients to deliver high-quality presentation design, corporate communication, and creative solutions.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to improve our online presence through SEO, quality backlink building, LinkedIn marketing, and B2B lead generation. The ideal candidate should be willing to learn, conduct online research, and help generate potential business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

* Conduct keyword research to identify relevant keywords and business opportunities.
* Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies to improve website rankings and organic traffic.
* Optimize website content, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, and internal links.
* Monitor keyword rankings, website traffic, and overall SEO performance.
* Identify SEO issues and recommend improvements to increase website visibility.

2. Backlink Building and Link Building

* Build quality backlinks through relevant websites, business directories, and industry platforms.
* Identify link-building opportunities through guest posting, outreach, and content promotion.
* Research competitor backlinks and identify potential link-building opportunities.
* Maintain a backlink tracking sheet and monitor link quality.
* Follow ethical, white-hat SEO practices and avoid spammy link-building techniques.

3. LinkedIn Marketing and Business Development Support

* Develop and implement LinkedIn marketing activities to increase VGDS Global's brand visibility and professional network.
* Research and identify potential clients, companies, and decision-makers who may require presentation design and corporate communication services.
* Identify relevant LinkedIn profiles, companies, and business opportunities within target industries.
* Support LinkedIn outreach campaigns by connecting with potential clients and initiating professional conversations.
* Assist in creating and publishing LinkedIn posts, company updates, and other marketing content.
* Engage with relevant posts, professional communities, and industry discussions to improve brand awareness.
* Maintain LinkedIn prospect lists and track outreach activities, responses, and follow-ups.
* Explore opportunities to generate business inquiries through LinkedIn marketing.

4. B2B Lead Generation

* Generate qualified B2B leads for presentation design and corporate communication services.
* Research potential clients through LinkedIn, company websites, business directories, and other online platforms.
* Identify relevant decision-makers, including business owners, founders, marketing managers, consultants, and corporate professionals.
* Collect and maintain accurate lead information, including company names, contact details, LinkedIn profiles, and business requirements where available.
* Build and regularly update lead databases and prospect lists.
* Support targeted email marketing and LinkedIn outreach campaigns to generate potential business opportunities.
* Track leads, responses, follow-ups, and lead conversion progress.
* Coordinate with the team to identify target markets and improve lead generation strategies.

5. Reporting and Performance Tracking

* Use tools such as Google Analytics and Google Search Console to monitor website performance.
* Track keyword rankings, backlinks, organic traffic, LinkedIn engagement, outreach activities, and leads generated.
* Maintain weekly activity reports and prepare monthly performance summaries.
* Stay updated on SEO practices, LinkedIn marketing trends, and B2B lead generation techniques.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; relevant digital marketing training or certifications are an advantage.
* 0–1 year of experience in digital marketing, SEO, LinkedIn marketing, or lead generation.
* Basic understanding of SEO, keyword research, backlink building, and website optimization.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, professional networking, and online business research.
* Basic understanding of B2B lead generation, prospect research, and email outreach.
* Knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or lead management tools is an advantage.
* Good written English and professional communication skills.
* Strong research, organizational, and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail when collecting and maintaining lead data.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and willing to learn new digital marketing tools and techniques.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet assigned targets.

Work Model

* Hybrid work arrangement, primarily remote.
* One mandatory office visit per month for meetings, reviews, and coordination.
* Regular online communication and progress reporting are expected.

Salary and Growth

* Opportunity to gain practical experience in SEO, backlink building, LinkedIn marketing, and B2B lead generation.
* Salary revisions and career growth may be considered based on performance, skill development, and business requirements.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates, aspiring digital marketers, and candidates with up to one year of experience who are interested in SEO, LinkedIn marketing, online business research, and B2B lead generation.

Candidates who enjoy researching companies, identifying potential clients, building professional connections, and supporting digital marketing campaigns are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their updated resume to **hr@vgdsglobal.com** with the subject line:

**Application for Digital Marketing Executive – VGDS Global LLP**

candidates can also **message us on WhatsApp at +91 9249539270**.

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Website:** cosysta.com

**Experience:** 5\+ years in marketing, preferably in IT services, SaaS, software, or technology consulting

About Cosysta

Cosysta is an AI\-powered technology and digital solutions company delivering websites, software, mobile applications, ERP systems, AI solutions, digital marketing, and business automation services.

We are looking for a **Chief Marketing Manager** who can build and lead our marketing function, strengthen the Cosysta brand, generate qualified business opportunities, and establish a scalable marketing system for domestic and international markets.

Job Summary

The Chief Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and managing Cosysta’s overall marketing strategy. The role combines **brand building, digital marketing, lead generation, content strategy, campaign management, marketing analytics, and team leadership**.

The ideal candidate should be capable of converting marketing efforts into measurable business outcomes and building a structured marketing department from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Marketing Strategy \& Leadership**

* Develop and execute Cosysta’s overall marketing strategy.
* Build quarterly and annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
* Establish marketing processes, workflows, KPIs, and reporting systems.
* Lead and manage the marketing team, agencies, freelancers, and external partners.
* Coordinate with sales, product, design, and development teams.

**2\. Brand Development**

* Strengthen Cosysta’s positioning as an AI\-powered technology and business solutions provider.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across websites, social media, proposals, advertisements, and campaigns.
* Develop brand messaging for Indian, GCC, European, and US markets.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, events, industry visibility, and thought leadership.

**3\. Digital Marketing \& Lead Generation**

* Plan and manage SEO, AEO, social media marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, email marketing, and content marketing.
* Generate qualified leads for software development, ERP, AI solutions, websites, and digital services.
* Build and optimize landing pages, lead funnels, remarketing campaigns, and conversion systems.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets based on results.
* Work with the sales team to improve lead quality and conversion rates.

**4\. Content \& Communication**

* Develop content strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, blogs, and other relevant channels.
* Oversee marketing creatives, videos, case studies, presentations, brochures, and proposals.
* Create content that communicates business value rather than merely promoting software features.
* Coordinate with designers, video editors, copywriters, and technical teams.

**5\. Market Research \& Growth**

* Research competitors, industry trends, customer segments, and emerging markets.
* Identify new marketing channels, partnerships, and business opportunities.
* Develop market\-entry strategies for target regions.
* Track competitor positioning, pricing communication, and promotional activities.
* Support product marketing for Cosysta’s software and business automation solutions.

**6\. Analytics \& Performance**

* Define and monitor marketing KPIs such as:
* Qualified leads generated
* Cost per lead
* Marketing\-qualified leads
* Conversion rate
* Customer acquisition cost
* Website traffic and conversions
* Campaign ROI
* Brand reach and engagement
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports for management.
* Use tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, CRM platforms, and reporting dashboards.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* **5\+ years of relevant marketing experience**, preferably in IT, SaaS, software, digital services, or technology companies.
* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing and lead generation.
* Strong understanding of SEO, paid advertising, social media, content marketing, and conversion optimization.
* Experience managing marketing teams or external marketing resources.
* Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and leadership skills.
* Ability to create and execute marketing strategies independently.
* Ability to work with technical teams and understand software products.

Preferred Skills

* Experience marketing software development, ERP, AI, SaaS, or IT services.
* Experience with B2B marketing and international lead generation.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn marketing and account\-based marketing.
* Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and funnel management.
* Understanding of AEO, AI search visibility, and modern content strategies.
* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms, Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Canva, or similar tools.
* Strong copywriting and campaign planning skills.
* Experience building a marketing department or marketing SOPs.

Key Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Build a structured and accountable marketing function.
* Establish a consistent lead\-generation pipeline.
* Improve Cosysta’s online brand presence and market positioning.
* Develop repeatable marketing campaigns and reporting systems.
* Support customer acquisition in India and international markets.
* Coordinate marketing activities with sales and business development.
* Demonstrate measurable improvement in marketing performance
